title: client: meta.getHistory, rollbackItem and diffItem cannot name a package, so a two-holder item's history is unreachable through the SDK (ADR-0150 D3, after #32905)
body:
epic:#31527#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvyhxPWfA8DsbmVYJ5

Filing gate ①: a product defect with named landing points, owed by PR #33193 (#32905), which scoped it out. Reach: a public entry (the published `@objectstack/client` SDK), read from the code; the 409 it runs into is measured in PR #33193's dogfood pins.

Parent: #32905 (source card). Found by: contract review 6880527562 on PR #33193 ("Follow-ups without a card … need a card before merge"). Twin of #23658 (`meta.publishItem` could not name a package).

- **Why:** a developer or agent scripting against the SDK reads or rolls back a flow, agent, skill or other per-package item that two packages hold. After PR #33193 the server answers a bare request 409 and names `?package=` as the remedy, but the SDK methods have no way to send it, so the remedy is unreachable through the SDK and the caller is stuck without hand-building URLs.
- **Reader:** the server lane's next seat on the epic #31527 line, after PR #33193 lands.
- **Duplicate search** (issues, open and closed, 2026-11-14): `is:issue diff history package holders` 139 hits, `is:issue getHistory package` 18, `is:issue history rollback action two shippers` 2. The only open hits on this surface are #32905 (the source card), #31699 and #31527 (the epic); #32351 (closed) made the manager path package-aware and #23658 (closed) is the publish twin of item B. None covers this item.

## Landing points

`packages/client/src/index.ts`:
- `meta.getHistory(type, name, { sinceSeq, limit })` (about line 2283) sends no `package`.
- `meta.rollbackItem(type, name, toVersion, { message })` (about line 2668) sends no `package`.
- `meta.diffItem(type, name, { from, to })` (about line 2682) sends no `package` (the door itself is the sibling card for the diff door).
- A second `getHistory` near line 8776 should be read for the same gap.

The console does not use these (it calls `ui/packages/data-objectstack`'s `history`/`rollback`, which PR #33193 already extends with `packageId`).

## Expected

Each method takes an optional `packageId` and sends it as `?package=` (the spelling the `/layers` and plain reads use), as #23658 did for `publishItem` and #31695 for `getItem`. Pins: the URL carries `package` when given and is unchanged when not.
